get.summary: Retrieves a Flight based on flight-id

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique numeric id of flight

get.summary: Retrieve flight IDs based on a datetime range
get.description: Returns a list of flight IDs for flights scheduled within the specified datetime range (filters on scheduleDateTime). Max date range is three days.

parameters.name: fromDateTime
parameters.description: From date of search period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss

parameters.name: toDateTime
parameters.description: To date of search period (inclusive). Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss

get.summary: Retrieves flights for a specific date
get.description:
Retrieves flights for a specific date. If scheduleDate is provided as query parameter, it will retrieve flights for that date. If not provided it is defaulted to today. If there are more hits then allowed on one page response headers will contain the URLs where other pages of the results can be reached.For example:
Link: <protocol://server_address:port/public-flights/resource> ; rel="first",
<protocol://server_address:port/public-flights/resource?page=10> rel="last",
<protocol://server_address:port/public-flights/resource?page=3> rel="next",
<protocol://server_address:port/public-flights/resource?page=1> rel="prev"

parameters.name: scheduleDate
parameters.description: Scheduled date to get flights for. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Defaults to today if not provided

parameters.name: scheduledate
parameters.description: See: scheduleDate. Prefer scheduleDate. If both scheduleDate and scheduledate are used scheduleDate takes precedence

parameters.name: scheduleTime
parameters.description: Scheduled time to get flights from. Format: HH:mm

parameters.name: flightName
parameters.description: Flight number as printed on the ticket

parameters.name: flightname
parameters.description: See: flightName. Prefer flightName. If both flightName and flightname are used flightName takes precedence

parameters.name: flightDirection
parameters.description: Direction of the flight

parameters.name: flightdirection
parameters.description: See: flightDirection. Prefer using flightDirection. If both flightDirection and flightdirection are used flightDirection takes precedence

parameters.name: airline
parameters.description: Prefix in flight number as printed on the ticket. For exmaple: KL. This can either be a 2-character (IATA) airline prefix or 3-character (ICAO) airline prefix. Only one airline (or airlineCode) can be queried at the same time.

parameters.name: airlineCode
parameters.description: NVLS code of an airliner.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: IATA or ICAO code of airport in route; multiple values, comma separated

parameters.name: includedelays
parameters.description: Include flights of earlier an scheduleDate when these have enough delay to shift to the date that is queried upon.

parameters.name: includeDelays
parameters.description: See: includedelays. Prefer includedelays. If both includeDelays and includeDelays are used, includedelays take precedence.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Specifies which field to use for sorting. Allowed values are flightName, scheduleDate, scheduleTime, flightDirection, mainFlight, airlineCode, id, and all fields from the searchDateTimeField parameter. Use plus or minus sign to indicate ascending or descending order. Multiple fields are allowed and should be separated by a comma. For example "-scheduleDate, +scheduleTime".

parameters.name: fromDateTime
parameters.description: From date of search period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss

parameters.name: toDateTime
parameters.description: To date of search period (inclusive). Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss

parameters.name: searchDateTimeField
parameters.description: Query by a specific DateTime field. Allowed fields are estimatedLandingTime, actualLandingTime, publicEstimatedOffBlockTime, actualOffBlockTime, expectedTimeBoarding, expectedTimeGateClosing, expectedTimeGateOpen, expectedTimeOnBelt, scheduleDateTime, lastUpdatedAt

parameters.name: fromScheduleDate
parameters.description: Query by ScheduleDate range.

parameters.name: toScheduleDate
parameters.description: Query by ScheduleDate range

parameters.name: isOperationalFlight
parameters.description: Query based on operational/non-operational flights.true for operational and false for non-operational flights

get.summary: Retrieves destination based on IATA code
get.description: Retrieves destination based on IATA code

parameters.name: iata
parameters.description: IATA code

RowType.description: Check-in row allocated to the flight.

BaggageClaimType.description: Baggage reclaim information for an arriving flight.

belts.description: Baggage reclaim belts where arriving passengers can collect their luggage.

CodesharesType.description: Codeshare flights related to the main flight.

codeshares.description: All flight names related to the main flight.

endTime.description: End time of the check-in allocation.

startTime.description: Start time of the check-in allocation.

dutch.description: Public name in Dutch. Example: Venetië.

english.description: Public name in English. Example: Venice.

Destination.description: Destination served by flights to or from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.

city.description: City name in English. Example: Venice.

country.description: Name of the country where the destination is located, in English.

iata.description: Three-letter IATA code of the destination airport. Example: VCE.

Airline.description: Passenger airline operating to or from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.

iata.description: Two-character IATA airline code. Example: KL.

icao.description: Three-letter ICAO airline code. Example: KLM.

publicName.description: Public name of the airline. Example: KLM.

AircraftType.description: Aircraft type operated on flights to or from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol.

iataMain.description: Three-character IATA main aircraft type code. Example: 739.

iataSub.description: Three-character IATA aircraft subtype code. Example: 73J.

longDescription.description: Long public name of the aircraft type. Example: Boeing 737-900 Winglets.

shortDescription.description: Short name of the aircraft type. Example: Boeing 737-900/W.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Time of the last update to the flight in the flight information system.

actualLandingTime.description: Actual landing time (ALDT): the time the aircraft landed on the runway. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

actualOffBlockTime.description: Actual off-block time (AOBT): the actual departure time from Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

aircraftRegistration.description: Registration of the aircraft that operates the main flight. Example: PHTFA.

estimatedLandingTime.description: Estimated landing time (ELDT) of an arriving flight at Amsterdam Airport Schiphol. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

expectedTimeBoarding.description: Expected time that passenger boarding starts. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

expectedTimeGateClosing.description: Expected time that the flight handler closes the gate. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

expectedTimeGateOpen.description: Expected time that the flight handler opens the gate. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

expectedTimeOnBelt.description: Expected time that the first baggage from the flight is on the reclaim belt. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

flightDirection.description: Direction of the flight: A = arrival, D = departure.

flightName.description: Flight name as shown on the passenger's ticket. Example: KL672.

flightNumber.description: Numeric part of the flight name. Example: 672.

gate.description: Gate from which passengers board the departing flight. Example: C12.

isOperationalFlight.description: Indicates whether the flight is operational (true) or non-operational (false).

mainFlight.description: For a codeshare, the flight name of the airline that operates the flight.

prefixIATA.description: Two-character IATA prefix of the operating airline. Example: KL.

prefixICAO.description: Three-character ICAO prefix of the operating airline. Example: KLM.

airlineCode.description: Numeric NVLS code of the airline.

publicEstimatedOffBlockTime.description: Publicly displayed expected departure time of a departing flight. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

scheduleDateTime.description: Scheduled departure or arrival date and time. Format: yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ

scheduleDate.description: Date on which the flight is scheduled to operate. Format: yyyy-MM-dd. Example: 2015-06-17.

scheduleTime.description: Time the flight is scheduled to depart or arrive. Format: hh:mm:ss. Example: 15:25:00.

serviceType.description: The service type category of the commercial flight. For example: J = Passenger Line, C = Passenger Charter, F = Freight Line and H = Freight Charter.

terminal.description: Schiphol terminal number used for departure or arrival.

destinations.description: IATA codes of the airports in the flight route.

eu.description: Route category: S (Schengen), E (Europe) or N (non-Europe).

visa.description: Indicates whether a visa is required for the destination.

AircraftTypeType.description: Aircraft type that operates the main flight.

iataMain.description: IATA main aircraft type code. Example: 739.

DeskType.description: Check-in desk allocated to the flight.

CheckinClassType.description: Check-in class allocated to the desk.

description.description: Description of the check-in class. Example: Economy.

TransferPositionsType.description: Transfer desks allocated to the flight.

transferPositions.description: Transfer desks allocated to the flight.

flightStates.description: Public flight status codes, such as BRD for boarding.

CheckinAllocationsType.description: Check-in desk allocations for the flight or its codeshare flights.

checkinAllocations.description: Check-in desk allocations for the flight or its codeshare flights.
